title: 2026-11-13 · Should personal work live apart from the open-source repo?
description: Decision: a sibling workspace beside the public repo, as Tinka does, rather than a private copy with a push-to-public rule. November 14, 2026: the migration plan was accepted and approved; migration in progress, starting with the workspace move. One choice open: host settings for the dev workspace. Markdown report and an 8-page telling. Facts, decisions and open items labelled.

build.message: Plan accepted and approved November 14; migration in progress.
